content_sections.heading: CSIR-URDIP Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. URDIP/06/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CSIR-URDIP notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Masters/Integrated Masters in Chemistry (preferably Organic Chemistry/ Pharmaceutical/Medicinal Chemistry/Polymer Chemistry) OR Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or Technology from a recognized University. Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on last date of application) Age relaxation: SC/ST/PwBD/Women 5 years, OBC 3 years Other conditions: Excellent Oral and Written Communication in English language. Aptitude for research publications, data mining and analytical skills. Proficiency in use of commonly used software for word processing, database searching, spreadsheets & presentations. Desirable: Knowledge of IPR/ Patent Analytics / Patent Law/ Patent Information Search and Analysis.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engagement will be made initially for a period of six months which may be extended or curtailed. Purely temporary basis and co-terminus with the tenure of the project or 06 years whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How Will CSIR-URDIP Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-In Interview Written exam or shortlisting based on criteria if large number of candidates appear Walk-In Interview on-site only Selection Committee may shortlist candidates based on written exam or percentage of marks or desirable qualifications if a large number appear

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original qualification and experience certificates One set of photocopies of certificates Duly filled Application form in prescribed proforma

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-URDIP Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill up the application form provided in the notification. Directly appear for the Walk-In interview on 26th Nov 2026 at the reporting time of 09.00 a.m. Bring original qualification and experience certificates along with one set of photocopies.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA-DA will be paid for attending the interview. No separate interview call letters will be issued. Hostel accommodation is available subject to availability, in which case HRA will not be admissible.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for CSIR-URDIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-URDIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Project Associate (PAT-I).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CSIR-URDIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 26 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on last date of application). Relaxation: SC/ST/PwBD/Women 5 years, OBC 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 31000+HRA or 25000+HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Masters/Integrated Masters in Chemistry or Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or Technology.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Excellent Oral and Written Communication in English language. Aptitude for research publications, data mining and analytical skills. Proficiency in use of commonly used software for word processing, database searching, spreadsheets & presentations.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-In Interview. Written exam or shortlisting based on criteria if large number of candidates appear. Walk-In Interview on-site only. Selection Committee may shortlist candidates based on written exam or percentage of marks or desirable qualifications if a large number appear.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement will be made initially for a period of six months which may be extended or curtailed. Purely temporary basis and co-terminus with the tenure of the project or 06 years whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pune.
